risks.reasoning: For the eight months ended August 31, 2022, the audited cash flow statement reports net cash flows used in operating activities of RMB59,969 thousand and cash and cash equivalents at period end of RMB87,696 thousand. Monthly operating cash burn is approximately RMB7,496 thousand and cash runway is approximately 11.70 months, below the 12-month medium threshold and at or above the 6-month high threshold.

The accountants' report shows losses for the year/period of RMB159,333 thousand, RMB126,497 thousand, RMB92,436 thousand and RMB61,422 thousand for 2020, 2021, 8M2021 and 8M2022 respectively. Four comparable loss periods meet the frozen high threshold.

Revenue increased from RMB12,061 thousand in 8M2021 to RMB16,431 thousand in 8M2022, an increase of approximately 36.23%. The latest comparable growth is positive and does not trigger the frozen negative-growth thresholds.

For 8M2022, the largest customer accounted for approximately 10.8% and the five largest customers accounted for approximately 40.3% of revenue. The top-five ratio reaches the frozen medium threshold of 30%, triggering a medium concentration risk.

For 8M2022, the largest supplier accounted for approximately 2.3% and the five largest suppliers accounted for approximately 9.6% of total purchases. Both ratios remain below the frozen medium thresholds of 30% and 60%.

The Pre-IPO Investors were granted customary special rights including divestment right, right of first refusal and tag-along rights, veto right, director/supervisor appointment right and anti-dilution right. No redemption right is disclosed, and all special rights were automatically terminated by December 27, 2021.

The formal Legal Proceedings and Regulatory Compliance section states that the Directors confirmed the Group was not involved in any legal, arbitral or administrative proceedings that, individually or in aggregate, would have a material adverse effect, and that the PRC Legal Adviser confirmed material compliance. No material pending matter was identified.

The Group has launched six commercialized minimally-invasive surgical consumables and generated product-sales revenue, but had not commercialized any cryotherapy systems as of the Latest Practicable Date. The Bladder Cryoablation System was approved for commercialization in June 2022 with commercialization planned for December 2022, and the Endoscopic Clip for Anastomosis was commercialized in October 2022. Because core cryotherapy products remain at or immediately before commercialization and revenue attribution to core products is not yet established, the risk is left as needs_review under OPEN-02.
